## Objective
This is to compute the distance to closest neighbor and distance to closest junction for each lymphocyte in included mucosa fragments. 

The analysis will be done per tissue fragment (after automatic filtering of inaadequate orientation
and artefact)

## Input
- included_mucosa.json 
- <image>_<fragment>_<mucosa>_<model_version>_mapped_to_mucosa_lymphocytes.geojson (fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_mucosa/output/map_to_mucosa)
Contains lymphocyte outline coordinates (mapped by compartment and layer)
- <image>_<fragment>_<mucosa>_<model_version>_mapped_to_mucosa.geojson (fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_mucosa/output/map_to_mucosa)
Contains layers, tissue compartments and lymphocyte outline coordinates (grouped by class)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(nngeo)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0) #problem opening large file w/o this

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"


#Calculates the distance to closest neighbor, and the distance to the villi/crypts junction
calculate_lymphocyte_distances <- function(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocytes, pixel_length_um) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(nngeo)
  

  villi <- mapped_to_mucosa %>% 
    filter(classification == "villi")
  
  crypts <- mapped_to_mucosa %>% 
    filter(classification == "crypts")

  junction <- st_intersection(
    st_boundary(st_union(villi)),
    st_boundary(st_union(crypts))
  ) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    rename(geometry = x)
  
  lymphocyte_centroids <- lymphocytes %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_centroid(geometry))

  lymphocyte_distances <- lymphocyte_centroids %>%
    mutate(
      closest_junction_px = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, junction)),
      closest_junction_um = closest_junction_px * pixel_length_um
    ) %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    lapply(function(group) {
      if (nrow(group) < 2) {
        # Not enough points for nearest neighbor
        group$closest_neighbor_px <- NA_real_
        group$closest_neighbor_um <- NA_real_
      } else {
        # Safe k = 2, self = FALSE ensures the closest *other* neighbor
        nearest_neighbor <- st_nn(group, group, k = 2, returnDist = TRUE)
        # Take the second  neighbor's distance (skip self)
        closest_neighbor_pxs <- sapply(nearest_neighbor$dist, `[`, 2)
        group$closest_neighbor_px <- closest_neighbor_pxs
        group$closest_neighbor_um <- closest_neighbor_pxs * pixel_length_um
      }
      return(group)
    }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(
      log_closest_junction_um = log10(closest_junction_um + 1),
      log_closest_neighbor_um = log10(closest_neighbor_um + 1)
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()

  return(lymphocyte_distances)
}

#Generate lymphocyte clusters
generate_lymphocyte_clusters <- function(lymphocytes, 
                                         pixel_length_um, 
                                         dbscan_eps_um, 
                                         dbscan_minPts, 
                                         buffer_um = 4) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(dbscan)
  library(tibble)

  lymphocyte_centroids <- lymphocytes %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_centroid(geometry))

  # Store all input classifications
  all_classifications <- unique(lymphocyte_centroids$classification)

  # Process each group
  results<- lymphocyte_centroids %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    lapply(function(group) {
      coords <- st_coordinates(group)
      eps_px <- dbscan_eps_um / pixel_length_um
      cl <- dbscan(coords, eps = eps_px, minPts = dbscan_minPts)
      group <- group %>% mutate(cluster_id = cl$cluster)
      
      cluster_sizes <- group %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(cluster_id > 0) %>% 
        count(cluster_id, name = "cluster_n_lymphocytes")

      group_clusters <- group %>%
        filter(cluster_id > 0) %>%
        group_by(cluster_id) %>%
        summarize(
          geometry = st_union(geometry),
          cluster_n_lymphocytes = n(),
          image_name = first(image_name),
          fragment_name = first(fragment_name),
          mucosa_name = first(mucosa_name),
          objectType = first(objectType),
          isLocked = first(isLocked),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(cluster_n_lymphocytes)) %>%
        mutate(
          classification = paste0(unique(group$classification), "_cluster"),
          name = paste(classification, sprintf("%03d", row_number()), sep = "_"),
          log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = log10(cluster_n_lymphocytes + 1)
        ) %>%
        st_buffer(dist = buffer_um / pixel_length_um) %>%
        select(image_name:mucosa_name, name, classification, cluster_n_lymphocytes, log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, objectType, isLocked, geometry)
      
      group_points <- group %>%
        left_join(cluster_sizes, by = "cluster_id") %>%
        relocate(cluster_id, cluster_n_lymphocytes, .after = geometry)
      
      list(clusters = group_clusters, lymphocytes = group_points)
    })

  # Bind together
  lymphocyte_clusters <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "clusters"))
  lymphocytes_with_id <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "lymphocytes"))

  # Identify classifications that were missing from output
  present_classes <- unique(lymphocyte_clusters$classification)
  expected_classes <- paste0(all_classifications, "_cluster")
  missing_classes <- setdiff(expected_classes, present_classes)

  # Generate NA-filled rows for missing classifications
  if (length(missing_classes) > 0) {
    fallback_rows <- lapply(missing_classes, function(class_label) {
      tibble(
        image_name = unique(lymphocytes$image_name)[1],
        fragment_name = unique(lymphocytes$fragment_name)[1],
        mucosa_name = unique(lymphocytes$mucosa_name)[1],
        name = paste0(class_label, "_000"),
        classification = class_label,
        cluster_n_lymphocytes = 0,
        log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = NA_real_,
        objectType = NA_character_,
        isLocked = NA,
        geometry = st_sfc(st_geometrycollection(), crs = st_crs(lymphocytes))
      )
    }) %>%
      bind_rows()
    
    lymphocyte_clusters <- bind_rows(lymphocyte_clusters, fallback_rows)
  }

  return(list(
    clusters    = lymphocyte_clusters,
    lymphocytes = lymphocytes_with_id
  ))
}

summarize_lymphocyte_features <- function(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_distances, lymphocyte_cluster_distances, pixel_area_um2) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(sf)
  
  expected_area_vars <- c(
  "crypts_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2", 
  "villi_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "villi_lamina_propria_area_um2")
  
  add_missing_area_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  
  #Calculate compartment areas per layer and epithelium crypts ratio
  areas_summary <- mapped_to_mucosa %>%
    filter(classification %in% c("villi_epithelium", "villi_lamina_propria", "crypts_epithelium", "crypts_lamina_propria")) %>%
    mutate(
      area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
      area_um2 = as.numeric(area_px2) * pixel_area_um2  # ensure numeric for pivoting
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, classification, area_um2) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste0(classification, "_area_um2")) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classification,
      values_from = area_um2
    ) %>%
    add_missing_area_vars(expected_area_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / 1000,
      crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = villi_epithelium_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = villi_lamina_propria_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = villi_epithelium_area_um2 / villi_lamina_propria_area_um2,
      crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2
    )

  # Summarize lymphocyte size and distances 
  
  expected_lymphocyte_vars <- c(
  "classification", "measured_area_um2", "closest_junction_um", "closest_neighbor_um",
  "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um", "cluster_n_lymphocytes")
  
  add_missing_lymphocyte_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
 
  
  lymphocytes_summary <- lymphocyte_distances %>%
    add_missing_lymphocyte_vars(expected_lymphocyte_vars) %>%
    select(all_of(expected_lymphocyte_vars)) %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    summarise(
      count = n(),
      
      mean_log_closest_neighbor_um = mean(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log_closest_neighbor_um = sd(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_neighbor_um = median(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_measured_area_um2 = mean(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_measured_area_um2 = sd(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      
      mean_log_closest_junction_um = mean(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log_closest_junction_um = sd(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_junction_um = median(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_junction_um = IQR(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      pct_cluster_ge_3  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 3) *100,
      pct_cluster_ge_5  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 5) *100,
      pct_cluster_ge_10  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 10) *100,
      pct_cluster_ge_15  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 15) *100,
      pct_cluster_ge_20  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 20) *100,
      pct_cluster_ge_25  = mean(!is.na(cluster_n_lymphocytes) & cluster_n_lymphocytes >= 25) *100,
      .groups = "drop"
      ) %>% 
    
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classification,
      values_from =  everything(), 
      names_glue = "{classification}_{.value}"
    )
  
  expected_cluster_vars <- c(
  "classification", "cluster_n_lymphocytes", "closest_junction_um", "closest_neighbor_um",
  "log_cluster_n_lymphocytes", "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um")
  
  add_missing_cluster_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  

  # Summarize lymphocyte clusters size and distances
  lymphocyte_clusters_summary <- lymphocyte_cluster_distances %>%
    add_missing_cluster_vars(expected_cluster_vars) %>%
    select(all_of(expected_cluster_vars)) %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    summarise(
      count = n(),
      median_cluster_n_lymphocytes = median(cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_cluster_n_lymphocytes = IQR(cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = median(log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = IQR(log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_closest_junction_um = median(closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_closest_junction_um = IQR(closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_junction_um = median(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_junction_um = IQR(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_closest_neighbor_um = median(closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_neighbor_um = median(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classification,
      values_from = c(
        count,
        median_cluster_n_lymphocytes, iqr_cluster_n_lymphocytes,
        median_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes,
        median_closest_junction_um, iqr_closest_junction_um,
        median_log_closest_junction_um, iqr_log_closest_junction_um,
        median_closest_neighbor_um, iqr_closest_neighbor_um,
        median_log_closest_neighbor_um, iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um
      ),
      names_glue = "{classification}_{.value}"
    )
  
  
  expected_vars <- c(
  "crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count", "crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2",
  "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count", "crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2",
  "crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count", "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count",
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count", "villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2",
  "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count", "villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2",
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count", "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count"
  )
  
  add_missing_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
        df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  
  # combine summarys and add area normalized counts
  summary <- bind_cols(areas_summary, lymphocytes_summary, lymphocyte_clusters_summary) %>%
    add_missing_vars(expected_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2,
      crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count / crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2 =
        crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count / crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2,
      villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2,
      villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_cluster_count / villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2 =
        villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_cluster_count / villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2)
  
  return(summary)
}


# Custom plotting function with median, quartile lines, and IQR printed
plot_histogram_density <- function(data, distance_var, classification_var){
  data %>%
    group_by({{classification_var}}) %>%
    mutate(
      median_val = median(.data[[distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q1 = quantile(.data[[distance_var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3 = quantile(.data[[distance_var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q3 - q1
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[distance_var]])) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "grey80", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_density(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median_val), color = "red", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = q1), color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = q3), color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(vars({{classification_var}}), scales = "free") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var, " for image:", data$image_name, ", fragment:", data$fragment_name, ", mucosa:", data$mucosa_name ),
      x = paste(distance_var, "(µm)"),
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf,
          label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\n",
                         "IQR = ", round(iqr, 2))),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 3, family = "Arial"
    )
}

plot_histogram_density_mean <- function(data, distance_var, classification_var){
  data %>%
    group_by({{classification_var}}) %>%
    mutate(
      median_val = median(.data[[distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q1 = quantile(.data[[distance_var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3 = quantile(.data[[distance_var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q3 - q1,
      mean_val = mean(.data[[distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val = sd(.data[[distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_2sd = mean_val + 2 * sd_val,
      lower_2sd = mean_val - 2 * sd_val
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[distance_var]])) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "grey80", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_density(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
    
    # Median and IQR
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median_val), color = "orange", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = q1), color = "lightgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = q3), color = "lightgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +

    # Mean and ±2 SD
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_val), color = "darkred", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = upper_2sd), color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = lower_2sd), color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7) +

    facet_wrap(vars({{classification_var}}), scales = "free") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var, " for image:", data$image_name, ", fragment:", data$fragment_name, ", mucosa:", data$mucosa_name ),
      x = paste(distance_var, "(µm)"),
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf,
          label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\n",
                         "IQR = ", round(iqr, 2), "\n",
                         "Mean = ", round(mean_val, 2), "\n",
                         "±2SD = [", round(lower_2sd, 2), ", ", round(upper_2sd, 2), "]")),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 3, family = "Arial"
    )
}
```

### Process batch 1

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(nngeo)

model_version <- "fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2"
subset_name <- "batch_1"

subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_batch_1.json") %>% select(image_name, pixel_length_um, pixel_area_um2)

mucosa_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/mucosa_metadata_batch_1.json") %>% 
  filter(image_name %in% subset$image_name) %>%
  left_join(subset) %>%
  filter(
    (orientation_class == "adequate" | orientation_class == "marginal") &
      (artefact_class == "adequate" | artefact_class == "marginal"))

image_fragment_mucosa_names <- mucosa_list$name

map_to_mucosa_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_mucosa/output/map_to_mucosa/"

features_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/"

lymphocyte_features_summaries <- NULL

for (img_frag_muc in image_fragment_mucosa_names[339:423]){
  
  message("Processing ", img_frag_muc)
  
  mucosa_info <- mucosa_list %>% filter(name == img_frag_muc)
  pixel_length_um <- mucosa_info$pixel_length_um
  pixel_area_um2 <- mucosa_info$pixel_area_um2
  
  mapped_to_mucosa_path  <- paste0(map_to_mucosa_dir, img_frag_muc, "_", model_version, "_mapped_to_mucosa.geojson")
  mapped_to_mucosa <- st_read(mapped_to_mucosa_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
           area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2)
  
  lymphocytes_path <- paste0(map_to_mucosa_dir, img_frag_muc, "_", model_version, "_mapped_to_mucosa_lymphocytes.geojson")
  
  lymphocytes <- st_read(lymphocytes_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0)
  
  #calculate distance to closest neighbor for lymphocytes
  lymphocyte_distances <- calculate_lymphocyte_distances(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocytes, pixel_length_um)
  
  #identify clusters of lymphocytes and generate 1)sep df with them 2) add cluster id to lcs
  cluster_list <- generate_lymphocyte_clusters(lymphocytes, pixel_length_um, dbscan_eps_um = 7, dbscan_minPts = 3, buffer_um = 4)
  
  lymphocyte_clusters <- cluster_list$clusters
  
  #if no cluster - count as cluster size 1
  lymphocytes_w_cluster_id <- cluster_list$lymphocytes  %>%
    select(name, cluster_id, cluster_n_lymphocytes) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  lymphocyte_distances <- lymphocyte_distances %>%
    left_join(lymphocytes_w_cluster_id)
  
  write_json(lymphocyte_distances, paste0(features_dir, "/lymphocyte_distances/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_distances.json"), pretty = TRUE)
  
  lymphocyte_distances <- fromJSON(paste0(features_dir, "/lymphocyte_distances/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_distances.json"))
  
  lymphocyte_variables_to_plot <- c("measured_area_um2", "closest_junction_um",  "closest_neighbor_um", "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um", "cluster_n_lymphocytes")
  
  
  lymphocyte_cluster_distances <- calculate_lymphocyte_distances(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_clusters, pixel_length_um)
  
 st_write(lymphocyte_clusters, paste0(features_dir, "lymphocyte_clusters/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_clusters.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  
  write_json(lymphocyte_cluster_distances, paste0(features_dir,"lymphocyte_clusters/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_cluster_distances.json"), pretty = TRUE)
  
  lymphocyte_cluster_distances <- fromJSON(paste0(features_dir,"lymphocyte_clusters/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_cluster_distances.json"))
  
  
  lymphocyte_features_summary <- summarize_lymphocyte_features(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_distances, lymphocyte_cluster_distances, pixel_area_um2)
  
  lymphocyte_features_summaries <- bind_rows(lymphocyte_features_summaries, lymphocyte_features_summary)
  
  
}

write_json(lymphocyte_features_summaries, paste0(features_dir, "feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty = TRUE)
  
```



### Explored distributions of the following in labl_2020_tuning
-lc_measured_area_um2 - normally distributed (mean, sd)
- lc_distance_to_closest_neighbor (left skewed - log transformation and median iqr)
- lc_distance to closest_junction (left skewed - log transformation makes it right skewed) log transformation and median iqr captures the center well
- cl_n_lc_left_skewed, log transf still left skewed but captures center better (median and iqr)
-cl_closest_neighbor - left_skewed - log transformatio nand median iqr captures it well
- cl_closest_junction - irregular - non log transformed captures the dist sligjlty better - 
kept them all in summary for now

```{r}
included_mucosa_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies//output/included_mucosa/included_mucosa_list.json") %>% 
  left_join(subset)

image_fragment_mucosa_names <- included_mucosa_list$name

  lymphocytes_path <- paste0(mapped_ai_output_dir, img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_centroids.geojson")

  write_json(lymphocyte_cluster_distances, paste0(output_dir,"lymphocyte_clusters/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_cluster_distances.json"), pretty = TRUE)
  
  cluster_variables_to_plot <- c("cluster_n_lymphocytes", "closest_junction_um",  "closest_neighbor_um", "log_cluster_n_lymphocytes", "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um")

    ggsave(filename = paste0(output_dir,"plots/lymphocyte_clusters_", clust_var, "/", img_frag_muc, "_", clust_var, ".tiff"),
           plot = plot,
           width =7,
           height = 3.5,

           dpi = 300,
           compression = "lzw")
  }
  
  lymphocyte_features_summary <- summarize_lymphocyte_features(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_distances, lymphocyte_cluster_distances, pixel_area_um2)
  
  lymphocyte_features_summaries <- bind_rows(lymphocyte_features_summaries, lymphocyte_features_summary)
  
  
}
```
